description: Per-model USD rates per 1M tokens, used by scripts/vajra-cost.sh. Cache-write is the base input rate × cacheWriteMult (5-min cache); cache-read is × cacheReadMult. Models absent here are reported by token count only (cost shown as '?') — we never fabricate a rate. Edit to add a model or correct a rate.
notes: match is a substring tested against the model id (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-8' matches 'opus').
First matching entry wins; order from most-specific to least if adding overlapping matches.
Token totals and cache-hit-rate are always accurate regardless of whether a rate is known.
